summary.interpretation: Sage replaces the previous SymPy factorization gap with true finite-field resultant factorization. A preserving factor must emit every original selected root pair. The root-scan count charges a conservative scan over the known hit roots after the factor selects a zero leaf, avoiding full A/B remainder evaluation. Preserving below-rho root-scan candidates are concrete follow-up leads; remainder-only wins would be stronger still.
